name: web/page
title: Responsive page
summary: One responsive page: semantic HTML, phone-first CSS with design tokens, no framework.
when: Use when the project needs a single public page such as a landing, info or documentation page.

title.about: The page title, shown in the browser tab, the header and the main heading.

description.about: One sentence that describes the page; used as the meta description and the line under the heading.
description.default: A small, fast page that stays readable on phones and desktops.

next: Write the files, replace the text marked KIWIBRO with the project's own, then open index.html at 360 px and at desktop width to check the layout.
